feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 27 September 2026 5:40am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

S or SE 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time in the afternoon, and then veering W by late afternoon. Gradually decreasing 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, perhaps rough for a time in the afternoon, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather)##

Area of rain, occasionally heavy, progresses northeastwards during the day, becoming mainly fair through the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing later.


##Wind)##

W or SW 3 or 4, backing S or SW in the morning, then SE in the afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate later. Perhaps touching rough in places by the end of the night.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tuesday, 29 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

SE 5 or 6, backing S overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, then for a time rain later.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good, becoming moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Wednesday, 30 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

S 5 or 6, decreasing SW 4 or 5 in the afternoon, veering W or SW 3 or 4 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Thursday, 1 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

W or SW 3 or 4, soon backing S or SW.


##State of sea)##

Slight.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 15°C

15°C
